A '''Z-95 Headhunter simulator''' was a machine used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to simulate flying a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], usually for training and learning purposes.<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
